description: What the producer of pr.ready does after emitting it: emit_only (default) starts nothing, and the designated train-role session runs the train (docs/operations/train.md); detached starts `scripts/train run` in the producer's container (Transport v0 as it was: the one-key rollback) (GX-06); wake fast-forwards train.wake_ref with a record naming the PR, its head and the pr.ready event, over git (no REST), and starts nothing: the train-role session's `scripts/train serve` consumes it (GATE-ON-PUSH R2).
